title: Complete the authenticated realtime result boundary

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Realtime boundary integration tests (development claims)
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_realtime_attempt_integration.py

verify.summary: Historical fresh independent verification passed the authenticated v1 result/non-success boundary, Attempt/session ownership, display-token hash scope, deterministic token/IP limiting, redaction and cleanup for AC-005/AC-006. Its NEEDS-CLARIFICATION applied because AC-004 was then treated as a development gate; the operator has now accepted AC-004 as production-only acceptance. No synthetic production PASS is claimed.

Historical Judge-supported HALT_QUALITY_GATES: the former task wording made the external AC-004 corpus an immediate development gate. The operator has since decided that AC-004 is production-only; this historical blocker is superseded by the narrowed development verification route and remains as provenance, not as a current source failure.
verify.resume_route: For the deferred production acceptance, after deployment an authorized owner provides a redacted manifest with 20 stable attempt_id values, evaluator role/criterion, ground truth for all four teasers and every complete-union photo_id, processed-selected-detection membership, per-Attempt verdict and server-correctness count >= 19/20; then run the production acceptance evidence route. This historical entry does not block the narrowed development closure.

verify.summary: Explicit owner-accepted closure: the existing independent evidence for FT-004-AC-005 and FT-004-AC-006 is accepted as sufficient for development closure. The former AC-004 blocker is superseded; FT-004-AC-004 remains a production-only residual risk under this task. Historical verification/closure verdicts are preserved; no AC-004 production PASS was created and no evidence was rechecked.

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-004 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the accepted gate is production-only and the authorized same-20 corpus/evaluator are unavailable in development; a synthetic pre-change RED would falsify the accepted setup. Alternative proof: after deployment, manually inspect all four teasers and every photo_id in N for participant membership represented by a processed selected detection, record one pass/fail row for each of the same 20 attempts and require at least 19 passing rows. Incomplete group-member coverage alone is not failure; retain the redacted evaluator record under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/. The count is independent of FT-005 QR/latency evidence.

FT-004-AC-005 RED: the current integrated result route lacks final proof of the completed display-Bearer hash authentication and deterministic test rate limiter; GREEN: preserve and re-prove through the final result route token-derived SPA only, rejection of absent/foreign/body override, configured per-token/IP 429 behavior and zero token/header/digest material in persisted/searchable logs; decisive comparison: public requests, owner rows and redacted log scan; artifact: security evidence under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/.

FT-004-AC-006 RED: nonzero insufficient/partial/repeated-Photo cases cannot reach typed domain outcomes and missing context has no completed operational evidence check; GREEN: missing date returns pre-admission 503 with bounded token-free evidence, partial current ready inventory is searched without a group gate, fewer than four returns insufficient_results with no session, repeated Photo contributes once to N, and every exact result/non-success response follows response version 1; decisive comparison: response/Attempt/session/evidence rows for each fixture; artifact: boundary integration evidence under .tasks/TASK-075-T3-FT-004-W5/.
purpose: Complete the authenticated realtime result boundary behind the exact public endpoint, prove the token-bound security and typed non-success behavior, and retain ownership of the deferred production server-correctness acceptance.
success_outcome: The development route returns a full result or exact typed non-success for bounded requests, preserves token-bound scope and idempotency, and satisfies AC-005/AC-006 without moving business rules into transport wiring. After independent verification, the task is eligible for done_for_prod; AC-004 remains a production-only server-correctness acceptance within this task and is not claimed before deployment.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement or re-own dependency claims for authentication, context, selection, search, assembly, persistence, slot or recovery.
Do not implement FT-005 rendering/acknowledgement/cooldown, FT-006 phone continuation or FT-007 detailed evidence.
Do not claim the FT-005 QR/under-10-second verdict or add production deployment actions.
Do not replace the authorized production AC-004 corpus/evaluator with local or synthetic evidence.

forbidden_scope: SpaPromoClient rendering/state, QR phone flow and detailed diagnostics UI/storage
Model download/fallback, ANN, waiter/replay infrastructure or another runtime role
Production secrets, operator/default rows or unredacted participant/credential artifacts
stop_conditions: The public route would need business orchestration in the FastAPI handler or a generic helper.
A complete outcome cannot be formed through the accepted Boundary Map edges and canonical response contract.
The development route would require a new product target, public contract or ownership decision beyond FT-004-AC-004..006.
The production AC-004 run would require changing the authorized evaluator, denominator or QR/latency criterion; stop and route that decision to the owning product/feature artifacts.

constraints: Keep the FastAPI entrypoint to authentication, validation, adapter binding, transaction/lifecycle wiring and response serialization; promo owns the use case.
Use explicit deterministic per-token/IP limits in tests and deployment-configured positive runtime values; never queue rate-limited requests.

Use task-owned display client, serving context, Photo/face/Attempt/session fixtures with known initial state, safe rerun identifiers, observable final rows and cleanup limited to those fixtures; the production corpus is authorized and retained only in redacted form.

Development closure proves AC-005/AC-006 with disposable fixtures. AC-004 is a deferred production-only server-correctness acceptance over the same stable 20-attempt corpus; no QR/latency evidence is required for this claim.
invariants: Transport rejection creates no core Attempt; every admitted request creates exactly one and terminal repeats run no second inference.
The body cannot override token-derived SPA and token/header/digest material never enters logs.
No-success, deadline, busy, interrupted or internal failure publishes a result session.

The local development evidence does not substitute for AC-004 production evidence; its same-20 count is independent of FT-005, uses no correctness-valid filter or joint pass set, and requires no cross-feature dependency.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-004 production acceptance records one server-correctness row for each of the same 20 stable attempts and requires at least 19 passing rows independently of FT-005's QR/latency count; no correctness-valid filter or joint pass set is used.
FT-004-AC-005 public-boundary fixtures prove hashed token scope, override rejection, 429 behavior and log redaction through result and non-success branches.
FT-004-AC-006 integration fixtures prove missing-date, partial-ready, insufficient-result and repeated-Photo outcomes with exact Attempt/session effects.
